title: CHATROUTER-001 routing isolation
message: Multi-worker conversation isolation remains unaccepted. AUTO-002, REMOTE-002 and SERVICE-002 confirmed sends collided onto one ChatGPT conversation and are not counted as independent active workers. Domain dispatch remains blocked pending a bounded unique-conversation gate.
action: Patch first-session create_session to force a genuinely new conversation and reject duplicate registered conversation URLs; validate uniqueness before any normal domain slot fill.
